1.mascotDialogue: A circular list looping around — this is intentional, a feature, done with care. The same shape appearing by accident, however, is a mistake. Same picture, opposite meaning entirely — so we paint them in different colors, deliberately.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 6 is the design. Line 13 is the consequence — you may never check `curr != NULL` to stop, because NULL never appears in a circular list. You must check `curr != head` instead.

3.mascotDialogue: That last arrow, c returning to a — drawn in the calm, closed-loop color. This loop belongs here. No need to worry.

4.mascotDialogue: See the difference? This arrow is in the warning color now, not the calm one — because this loop was never meant to exist, and traversal will spin on it forever, silently, without complaint.
